plugin_manager_button.what: Opens Maya's Plug-in Manager to see or unload plugins the scene needs.
examples: Unload mtoa before cleaning a scene that should not need Arnold.
Turn off "Auto load" on a plugin the rig should not need.

clean_arnold.tip: Save a copy without Arnold, then QUIT Maya.
clean_arnold.what: Saves the scene to a temp file, writes a clean copy without the mtoa (Arnold) lines, then closes Maya. Open Maya again and click Open Clean Scene.
steps: Open Maya and click Open Clean Scene.
examples: Click it when the scene asks for Arnold on machines that do not have it. Save your work first: Maya quits.
Clean a rig file before sending it to a client without Arnold.
clean_arnold.details: Saves %TEMP%/Arnold_Clean/dirty_scene.ma, writes clean_scene.ma without the lines that mention mtoa, then cmds.quit(force=True).

import_arnold_button.what: Opens the clean copy made by Clean Scene, deletes unknown nodes and saves it.
examples: Run Clean Scene first, then click it and save the file where you need it.
Open the clean scene and Save As over your rig file.
import_arnold_button.details: Opens %TEMP%/Arnold_Clean/clean_scene.ma, deletes unknown nodes and saves it in place (mayaAscii).
